review: Independent blind assessment of all 20 complete source texts

methodology.access: Read only the assigned source texts, repository instructions, git status and recent commit titles. Did not inspect tests, current expected values, baselines, project reviews, the journal, or other review outputs.

status_definitions.single: One source-supported value for the stated scope.
status_definitions.multiple: More than one source-supported value; retain the stated publication, contribution or location scope.
status_definitions.absent: The supplied source does not document the requested field.
status_definitions.unclear: A relevant candidate is present but the source does not clearly establish the requested field or its scope.

methodology.extent_rule: Numbered page extent records the leading numbered sequence in an explicit volume extent, preserving separate parenthesized unnumbered pages. Citation and contents page locators are not book extents.
methodology.language_rule: Report page-category language separately from an explicit body language label. Category-supported publication language does not establish a direct language statement in the body. German original titles in brackets do not make translated publications German.
methodology.scope_rule: No default selection of the first publication, translator or place. A scalar field may require an explicit policy even when every candidate value is clear.
methodology.errors_statement: Because the review is blind to extracted values and expectations, the summary identifies source contradictions and extraction pitfalls, not observed implementation failures.

clear_source_constraints.finding: Multiple publications supply distinct field values. Selecting the first source occurrence as uniquely correct erases documented alternatives.
Three translator credits have different scopes: R. Gal’perina for Mariia Stiuart, V. Levik for its verses, and P. S. Bernshteĭn for Kazanova. The editor is not a translator.
Editorial Juventud is explicitly a translator credit here. Alfredo Cahn is the translator of a different cited publication. Publisher attribution to Editorial Juventud is not directly stated.
Editor, foreword author and compiler credits do not state translators.
The supplied pagination is citation/contribution/reference location data, not a numbered book extent.
383/(1), 444/(3), 347/(1), and 254/(1) preserve separate numbered and unnumbered portions; the numbered values are 383, 444, 347, and 254 respectively.
The body explicitly says Language: Chechen. The source alone cannot justify replacing it with Czech. Czechoslovakia is a film-country heading and 32 minutes is runtime.
German and Arabic are explicitly separate body language sections, and both page categories are present.
The volume has both Bloemfontein and Kaapstad (Capetown) in its imprint. Pretoria belongs to a foreword attribution.
Preserve source spelling and role-specific spelling: publisher Suhrkakmp Verlag; translator Hymne Weiss despite Hymme Weiss in contents.

policy_dependent_ambiguities.issue: How a flat page entry represents multiple publishers, publication places, translators, extents or publication languages. The source supports scoped alternatives rather than one universally correct scalar.
Whether German may be inferred from title, German contents and series wording when neither the page category nor an explicit body label states the publication language.
Whether film country Czechoslovakia belongs in a general publication-place field.
Whether to preserve the full journal postal address, extract locality Chalfont St Giles, or leave publication place unconfirmed because the address is not explicitly labelled as such.
Whether the numbered Le Livre de Poche bracket is admissible as publisher metadata; the source directly establishes only a series/imprint label.
Place normalization must distinguish alternative names from multiple imprint cities while preserving the original source expression.
Metadata inheritance across reprints/later editions and page-level aggregation of fields that are supplied for only one publication require an explicit rule.
The explicit 444/(3)p. extent coexists with a contents locator ending at (445). Preserve both source statements; resolving physical pagination would require evidence beyond this source.

summary.absent_or_unsupported_is_valid: The cross-reference stubs and article/story citations often lack publishers, translators and book extents. These gaps should remain gaps unless separately sourced.
summary.actual_extraction_error_count_reason: No extracted values or expectations were inspected in this blind review.
